summary: Updates keep their database access by themselves, without re-running the install.

new.title: Database access kept up to date
new.text: Each update keeps the database setup identity in the SQL admin group and renews a time-limited assignment before it ends. You no longer re-run the install for this.
new.action: Run the install once more to grant the update job its new permissions; the update job reports any it still lacks.

new.title: Safe replacement of the SQL admin group
new.text: An optional install switch replaces a SQL admin group that is not role-assignable. It keeps the old group and moves back if sign-in fails.
